title: Snapshot
description: Full point-in-time matchmaking state, returned by GET /state on ClashEngine's ControlListenUrl (X-Api-Key authenticated). This is the self-heal companion to the outbound event stream (event.schema.json): the stream is fire-and-forget and may drop events under backpressure, so a consumer rebuilds its world from a snapshot on (re)connect and then applies events incrementally. Players are in-game names; queue ids match the event stream's queueName.

schemaVersion.description: Wire format version, shared with command.schema.json.

capturedAt.description: When the snapshot was taken (engine clock).

queues.description: Every registered queue, including empty ones, ordered by queueName.

matches.description: Every in-flight (Forming or Live) match. Finalized matches never appear -- they arrive as match.ended events and match uploads.

penalties.description: Every currently-active queue-timeout: one entry per (player, penalty kind) whose timeout has not yet expired.

queueName.description: Registry id ("{ownerArena}/{baseName}"), the same key events and commands use.

queueLabel.description: Operator-chosen display string, falling back to the queue's base name.

gameType.description: Registry name of the queue's game type; null for legacy/test queues.

capacity.description: Total players the queue's match shape needs (TeamCount * PlayersPerTeam).

enqueuedAt.description: When the player first joined the queue (liveness refreshes don't move this).

group.description: Opaque group tag shared by party members who queued together; null for solo entries.

matchId.description: Match id, correlating to match.started/match.ended events and cancel_match commands.

gameType.description: Registry name of the game type.

queueName.description: Registry id of the queue the match formed from (for form_match matches, the anchor queue). Null only if the queue was since removed by a config reload.

state.description: Engine match state. Forming = between teams-locked and GO!; Live = playing.

startedAt.description: When the match went live; null while Forming.

teams.description: Rosters, one inner array of in-game names per team, in team-index order.

player.description: In-game name of the penalized player.

kind.description: Which penalty ladder the timeout comes from.

offenseCount.description: Position on the ladder: consecutive offenses within the policy's memory window.
